subject: science
title: Photosynthesis — Practice
description: A short timed practice quiz with hints and answer explanations.

questions.question: What does a green plant mainly need for photosynthesis?
questions.hint: Think about what enters the process.

options.feedback: Correct. These are the main inputs.
Oxygen is mainly a product of photosynthesis.
Photosynthesis depends on light energy, normally sunlight, and carbon dioxide.
These are products, not the main inputs.

questions.explanation: Photosynthesis uses light energy, water and carbon dioxide to make glucose and release oxygen.

questions.question: Which gas is released during photosynthesis?
questions.hint: Look at the products of the equation.

options.feedback: Carbon dioxide is used by the plant.
Nitrogen is not the gas produced in this process.
Hydrogen gas is not released in the basic photosynthesis process.

questions.explanation: Oxygen is one of the products of photosynthesis.

questions.question: What is the role of chlorophyll?
questions.hint: It is the green pigment in leaves.

options.feedback: Roots and transport tissues move water.
Plants do not produce soil through chlorophyll.

questions.explanation: Chlorophyll absorbs light energy that helps drive photosynthesis.
